name: 엇갈린 기준
prompt: Wide 2:1 editorial illustration for an internal company newsletter. An employee is about to submit an approval request but pauses between two conflicting sources: a shared document on a monitor and a team conversation on a laptop. Represent the conflicting instructions with two clearly different arrangements of simple colored shapes, without any writing. The employee turns toward a colleague, who is searching through old folders. A neatly prepared stack of retrieved materials sits unused nearby: finding information was quick, establishing which version is valid is the obstacle. Observational ink drawing with restrained watercolor, realistic office details, thoughtful expressions, generous negative space. No text, letters, numbers, logos, or watermarks anywhere.

name: 회의 끝의 한 번
prompt: A cinematic, photorealistic corporate editorial photograph in a wide 2:1 composition. Capture the quiet final moment of a meeting in a contemporary Korean office. Several colleagues are gathering their belongings while one remaining product manager confirms an update on a tablet beside the meeting notes. The tablet shows a single clean document silhouette and one simple circular confirmation control, entirely without writing. Another colleague remains beside the manager, looking at the same document. Make this ordinary act of maintaining a shared reference the visual focal point. Natural afternoon light, candid human gestures, warm wood, understated realism, no futuristic effects. No text, letters, numbers, logos, or watermarks anywhere.

name: 모두의 기준서
prompt: Create a tactile paper-cut editorial artwork in a wide 2:1 format. A single open reference binder forms a large shared worktable at the center. Around it, five small paper-crafted office workers carry out different tasks, all consulting the same open spread. Its pages contain only a coherent arrangement of colored geometric blocks. One worker replaces a small removable section with a fresh piece while everyone continues working, expressing that shared knowledge stays useful through routine updates. Keep the binder welcoming and practical, with no magical glow. Ivory paper, deep navy, muted coral, visible paper fibers and soft dimensional shadows. Simple composition readable at email-header size. No text, letters, numbers, logos, or watermarks.

name: 확인을 기다리는 시간
prompt: A conceptual editorial illustration, wide 2:1, about waiting for someone to verify the current company rule. In the foreground, a capable office worker has completed a tidy stack of documents but cannot proceed: the stack is attached to an enormously long, loosely coiled telephone cord leading to a busy colleague searching an archive. The cord occupies much of the composition, turning waiting into a visible physical distance. Use believable human proportions with this single surreal exaggeration. The worker looks patiently stalled, not incompetent or distressed. Sophisticated colored-pencil texture, muted blue and warm orange, spacious pale background, a gently witty magazine-cover sensibility. No text, letters, numbers, logos, or watermarks.

name: 최신 결정으로 갈아 끼우기
prompt: A minimalist studio still life for a company newsletter, wide 2:1 composition. Show a beautifully made open ring binder on a clean desk, photographed from a low oblique angle. Two human hands are replacing one outdated reference sheet with a fresh sheet, keeping the rest of the binder intact. The removed sheet rests visibly outside the binder, slightly faded; the incoming sheet has crisp colored geometric diagrams with no writing. Three different workstations appear softly out of focus behind this one shared reference. Emphasize care, maintenance, and the modest physical action that makes information dependable for everyone. Precise material textures, soft daylight, quiet confidence, ample negative space. No text, letters, numbers, logos, or watermarks anywhere.
